links.outcome: Symptom checker Top-5 hit accuracy compared with physicians and comparator symptom checkers on same vignettes
links.effect: Ubie Top-5 hit accuracy 63.4%, Top-10 71.6%; compared favorably to the median physician hit accuracy and comparator symptom checkers.
links.quote: When compared to physicians and comparator SC’s that used the same clinical vignettes set, Ubie compared favorably to the median physician hit accuracy.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted simulation method for medical entity linking of clinical vignettes to a symptom checker with physician supervision

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of the Ubie AI symptom checker using a simulated clinical vignette benchmark, without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
